digest.component_or_area: DET code-review criterion + test timing assertions
propositions: Upper-bound wall-clock time assertions in tests cause CI flake under runner contention and must be detected and escaped or migrated to counting proxies.

Detector must block unescaped upper-bound assertions via two valid escapes: reasoned '# timing: hang-guard — <reason>' marker or @pytest.mark.skipif(CI) perf-lane guard, teaching both in rejection message.

Two migration sites (test_config_perf.py:201 spy cfg._ordered_layers for cache misses; test_enrich_drain.py:261 count pending_enrichment probes) must assert on proxy state, proven by RED-sim tests when regression injected.
Nine remaining in-scope sites must carry reasoned hang-guard markers; bare @pytest.mark.benchmark alone does not escape the detector.
Detector must be wired as CI gate step in _build-and-test.yml and have 13-test unit suite with fire cases, both escape types, and lower-bound exclusion.
